Our Safari Packages

Expertly crafted journeys through Uganda and East Africa — from gorilla treks to summit climbs

3 Days Wildlife Safari

3 Days Queen Elizabeth National Park Safari

Experience the wild heart of Uganda in Queen Elizabeth National Park – home to tree-climbing lions, massive hippo pods, savannah elephants, and over 600 bird species. This 3-day adventure balances game drives, a scenic Kazinga Channel boat cruise, and golden savannah sunsets.

From $650 pp

2 Days Gorilla Trekking

2 Days Gorilla Tracking – Kigali to Bwindi

A perfectly crafted 2-day gorilla trek combining the convenience of flying into Kigali, Rwanda, with the breathtaking wilderness of Bwindi Impenetrable Forest in Uganda. Come face-to-face with habituated mountain gorilla families in their misty jungle home.

From $800 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
2 Days Primate Safari

2 Days Chimpanzee Tracking at Kibale

Kibale National Park is East Africa's premier primate destination — home to 1,500 chimpanzees and 12 other primate species. Immerse yourself in lush tropical forest tracking wild chimpanzees with expert naturalist guides.

From $450 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
3 Days Wildlife Safari

3 Days Murchison Falls Safari

Murchison Falls is Uganda's largest national park and one of Africa's greatest wildlife theatres — where the Nile explodes through a 7-metre rock gap creating the world's most powerful waterfall. Game drives, boat cruises and the falls top viewpoint all await.

From $700 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
5 Days Gorilla Trekking

5 Days Gorilla Trekking & Lake Bunyonyi

An exceptional 5-day Uganda safari combining the world's greatest wildlife encounter — mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi — with a relaxing finale on the stunning terraced shores of Lake Bunyonyi, Africa's second deepest lake.

From $1,200 pp

3 Days Boat Cruise

3 Days Queen Elizabeth & Kazinga Channel Cruise

A tailor-made safari focused on the world-famous Kazinga Channel boat cruise at Queen Elizabeth National Park — where the wildlife density along the riverbanks is exceptional: hundreds of hippos, Nile crocodiles, elephants drinking at the water's edge, and 600+ bird species.

22 Days Cultural Tour

22 Days Complete Uganda Cultural Circuit

The ultimate Uganda experience — a complete 22-day circuit visiting every cultural region of the country. Northern plains, Eastern highlands, Western crater lakes, and Southern forests — all Uganda's greatest wildlife and cultural treasures in one epic journey.

4 Days Mountain Climbing

4 Days Mount Kenya Trekking

Mount Kenya (5,199m) is Africa's second highest peak and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Trek through equatorial forests, giant heather zones and glacial valleys to reach Point Lenana at 4,985m — a life-changing high-altitude adventure.

From $890 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
7 Days Mountain Climbing

7 Days Mount Kilimanjaro Climbing

Conquer Africa's highest peak — Mount Kilimanjaro (5,895m) — on the scenic Machame Route, known as the 'Whiskey Route' for its dramatic scenery. A life-changing 7-day ascent through five distinct climate zones to the Roof of Africa.

From $2,100 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
7 Days Cultural Tour

7 Days Western Uganda Cultural Tour

Explore the rich cultural tapestry of western Uganda — from the ancient kingdoms of Ankole and Bunyoro to the vibrant Bwindi Batwa community and the stunning crater lakes of Fort Portal. A soul-enriching journey through Uganda's most culturally diverse region.

From $1,800 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
8 Days Mountain Climbing

8 Days Rwenzori Mountain Trekking – Margherita Peak

The Rwenzori Mountains — the mythical Mountains of the Moon — are one of Africa's most coveted and challenging trekking destinations. Summit Margherita Peak (5,109m), the third highest point in Africa, through alien Afro-alpine vegetation unlike anywhere on Earth.

From $2,800 pp
